name: Office 365 - Exchange - Mailbox Audit - Client Locations - New
title: Office 365 - Exchange - Mailbox Audit - Client Locations - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Microsoft/Office365 "\"Workload\":\"Exchange\"" "\"RecordType\":2" ClientIPAddress // 2 stands for ExchangeItem - Events from an Exchange mailbox audit log for actions that are performed on a single item, such as creating or receiving an email message.
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"RecordType\":*," as RecordType 
| parse "\"ClientIPAddress\":\"*\"" as ClientIPAddress 
| where Workload="Exchange" and RecordType=2 and ClientIPAddress<>""
|where if ("{{clientipaddress}}" = "*", true, clientipaddress matches "{{clientipaddress}}")
|count by ClientIPAddress
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = ClientIPAddress
| where !isNull(latitude)
| count by ClientIPAddress, latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count
|where if ("{{region}}" = "*", true, region matches "{{region}}")

| parse "\"RecordType\":*," as RecordType
| parse "\"ClientIPAddress\":\"*\"" as ClientIPAddress 
| where Workload="Exchange" and RecordType=2 and ClientIPAddress<>""
| timeslice 1h

| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = ClientIPAddress
| where country_name<>""
| count by _timeslice, country_name
| transpose row _timeslice column country_name
